correctness.rationale: Direct all-dimensional Euclidean halfspace projection is feasible for every crown constraint; the norm is exactly h_n times the sole violation. Independence and beta convolution of uniform-simplex marginal masses give the full distribution, independent normal/tangent factorization, and exact moments. Regular-simplex tight-frame algebra yields exact covariance; gamma CLT proves Gaussian tangent and beta-tail proves exponential depth. Standalone exact-rational projection and numerical quadratic programming verify critical formulas in separate finite checks; no infinite claim rests on the tests.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The sparse-paving ambient hypersimplex is not the product of two simplices, and Q_n is not a matroid base polytope in the canonical paired-coordinate embedding: its missing same-color vertex pairs and forbidden diagonal violate rank-two parallel-class transitivity. Hence that theorem does not logically imply the crown-specific residual-direction law, although the homothetic cap method is similar and credited. The deleted-biclique result does not cover deletion of an entire perfect matching, nor a general interior projection law. A more general unlocated metric truncation theorem remains a residual risk.

originality.rationale: The exact same crown root polytope was previously analyzed for volume deficit, Hausdorff distance and Gaussian-direction width loss, which are explicitly credited. Closest prior sparse-paving hypersimplex theorem shares a beta truncation idea but does not subsume the crown product or its n-direction residual-vector law and joint Gaussian tangent limit. A separate Ferrers-biclique result covers a different deletion and only deleted-vertex distances. Full primary source material was compared, with residual possibility of a general unindexed truncation theorem acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed general Euclidean projection theorem for disjoint corner pyramids could imply the scalar beta subclaim and possibly the full statement.
The model-specific crown law has no independent historical-priority or mathematical audit.

value.rationale: The previously known crown-graph root polytope has exponentially small removed volume and nonvanishing Hausdorff gap, but those statistics do not describe error at typical points. This theorem supplies the complete interior Euclidean projection-error vector law, exact covariance operator and conditional independent normal/tangent scales, supplying quantitative geometric and sampling interpretation of the extreme-vs-typical separation. It explicitly does not claim standard beta formulas as an independent discovery.
